title: Take the guided tour
summary: The Tour button (or Help > Guided Tour) starts a step-by-step overlay that points at parts of the window.
alternateQueries: How do I take the tour?

steps.instruction: Click Tour in the header, or choose Help > Guided Tour.
steps.expectedResult: An overlay shows "Step 1 of N" with a title and text and highlights a part of the window.

steps.instruction: Use Next and Previous to move through the steps, Skip to leave early, and Done on the last step.

blocks.text: The tour's text has not been reviewed against the current application and may describe screens or buttons that have changed. When the tour and this help disagree, trust this help.
